shortDescription: COFCO International has agreed to buy two sugar mills in Brazil from fellow crop merchant Bunge NYSE:BG, the Chinese-owned firm said in a statement on Tuesday.The deal will cover the Rio Vermelho and Nova Unialco sugar mills. The value of the transaction was not disclosed.
